name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 26 - Am 49
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 26c. Calls for the next EU budget to include a programme protecting productive sectors and jobs, targeting those countries which, throughout the integration process, were the most disadvantaged by common policies, Economic and Monetary Union and the single currency;
